title: Decode Ways
keyIdea: ways[i] = number of ways to decode s[i..]. If s[i] is 1–9 it is a letter → ways[i + 1]; if s[i..i+1] is 10–26 it is a letter → + ways[i + 2]. '0' alone is never a letter. Fill from the end; only two values are needed.

approaches.name: DP with two variables
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). next = ways[i + 1] (starts at 1 for the empty rest), next2 = ways[i + 2]; cur = 0 if s[i] is '0', else next + (two-digit ok ? next2 : 0).
approaches.why: One pass from the end; two ints.
